subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should this PR be authorized to advance the per-agent SQLite schema from v11 to v12 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics?
rationale: The repository AGENTS.md requires explicit user discussion and acceptance before any SQLite schema-version bump; the review context does not show that approval.

options.title: Approve the v12 migration
options.body: Explicitly accept the schema advance after reviewing the upgrade contract and the supplied real existing-state proof.

options.title: Avoid the schema bump
options.body: Retain or redesign the ACP diagnostic storage so this journal migration does not require a per-agent schema-version advance.

recommendation.title: Approve the v12 migration
recommendation.body: Explicitly accept the schema advance after reviewing the upgrade contract and the supplied real existing-state proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite migration makes jalehman the strongest history-based owner for the adjacent per-agent schema boundary.
